PREPARATION CHECKLIST

Preparing to discuss your will

Print this page and make notes at your own pace. Bring your questions to a qualified professional. This is a preparation aid, not a legal document or personalised advice.

  • □A list of my assets and debts
  • □The people I would like to provide for
  • □Questions about who to nominate as executor
  • □Arrangements I would like to discuss for minor children
  • □Any existing will and where the original is stored
  • □Life changes that may affect my wishes

Other notes & questions

Keep completed checklists private. This website does not collect or store the information you write on your printed copy.
